culturalBackground: Flowers are among the most common motifs in every henna tradition, from Indian and Pakistani mehndi to Arabic and Gulf styles.
The lotus is a frequent motif in South Asian designs, where it is associated with purity and beauty.
Large roses with shaded petals are a signature of Arabic and Gulf-style henna.
Vines and leaves are used to connect separate flowers into one flowing design.
applicationTips: Draw the centre of each flower first, then build the petals outward so the spacing stays even.
For shaded petals, drag a little paste inward from the outline while it is still wet.
Vary the size of the flowers; one large bloom with smaller ones around it looks more balanced than many of the same size.

faqPool.q: Which flowers are used most in mehndi designs?
faqPool.a: Roses, lotuses and simple five-petal flowers are the most common, usually joined by vines and leaves.

faqPool.q: Are floral mehndi designs good for beginners?
faqPool.a: Yes. A flower is built from simple curves and dots, so floral trails are one of the first designs most people learn.

faqPool.q: What is shading in floral mehndi?
faqPool.a: Shading means dragging a thin layer of paste inside a petal so it stains lighter than the outline, which gives the flower depth.
